g.text: US-07: Failover - Leader crash, clean shutdown (compare-before-DEL), and follower takeover
SET XX PX is NOT safe: it overwrites the value
without checking who currently holds the key.
A slow old leader could steal a lease already
acquired by a new leader using SET XX PX.
The Lua GET+PEXPIRE pattern prevents this.
crash — lease renewal stops — TTL counts down
Key is automatically deleted by Redis.
OK (lease acquired — Instance B is now leader)
Failover complete within one TTL window.
No duplicate alerts: B was not evaluating while A held the lease.
Deterministic alert_id + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING handles
the case where A published to Kafka before crashing
but did not commit the Kafka offset — B re-processes safely.
Instance A is shutting down gracefully.
Must NOT delete the lease if a new leader
1 (deleted own lease) or 0 (new leader holds it — skip DEL)
If B already acquired the lease, DEL is skipped.
